# WIDA data structure fixtures

The six .cpp files preserve exact source bytes from hh2048/XCPC tree `cfdb12db6792eb2303798541fb5c760ed2bc618b`. Full upstream paths and Git blob IDs are listed in provenance.json and verified by tests/wida_basic_ds.py before compilation.

The upstream GPL-3.0 license is preserved in LICENSE. These comparison fixtures are not relicensed under the root MIT license. Namespaces and caller-provided Info/Merge types live in the test harness, outside the exact source bytes.

See docs/WIDA-BASIC-DS.md for interface conversions, supported domains and remaining application gaps.
